lines.tts: [intrigued] Humans didn't invent writing for poems. They invented it for... receipts.
lines.text: Humans didn't invent writing for poems. They invented it for... receipts.

lines.tts: Five thousand years ago, in Sumer, Nisa kept the city's grain.
lines.text: Five thousand years ago, in Sumer, Nisa kept the city's grain.

lines.tts: [cheerful, cheeky] Lend me ten sacks! I pay you back after harvest!
lines.text: Lend me ten sacks! I pay you back after harvest!

lines.tts: Nisa had no proof. Just her memory... against his.
lines.text: Nisa had no proof. Just her memory... against his.

lines.tts: [building] So next time, she pressed ten marks into wet clay... and made him press his seal beside them.
lines.text: So next time, she pressed ten marks into wet clay... and made him press his seal beside them.

lines.tts: [triumphant] Paid in full. Soon the whole city was writing down who owes what.
lines.text: Paid in full. Soon the whole city was writing down who owes what.

lines.tts: Writing didn't start with stories. It started with trust. Memory lies. Clay doesn't.
lines.text: Writing didn't start with stories. It started with trust. Memory lies. Clay doesn't.
